Native payment children finish before Juewu effects, including Silver Lion recovery, original Wooden Ox grain batches and source loss; accepted original material is paid once.

validation.scope: Development focused and routine verification only. No manual full run, packaging, release, push or complete manual foreground match was performed. Dedicated unresolved client FAQ interpretations are recorded above.

operatorGuide.authority: First-party 4399 operation portal guide for its anniversary game service. Supplementary client-specific derived-card and interaction evidence; the developer hero and release remain the identity authority.

officialEquipmentFix.summary: Fixes equipment cards sometimes being unavailable for Juewu conversion; printed rank-two owned equipment remains an eligible source.

engineeringInterpretations: Juewu's foreign rank applies only during the current uninterrupted Hand residency whose actual gain source is another character's owned zone. Leaving Hand ends that identity; reacquiring the same entity from DrawPile or DiscardPile does not revive it.

Juewu retains each original rank-two Hand, Equipment or formal Wooden Ox grain entity and uses native true-Use payment, targets, counters and child resolutions. Pure Played/response-only provision cannot consume a Juewu output allowance. Accepted native uses retain their issued payment rights after source loss.

The damage output family is the three existing Slash kinds, Duel, Barbarian Assault, Arrow Barrage, Fire Attack and the anniversary Wumiao Flood. The existing CardKind output-name convention gives each conversion its own actual-turn allowance. The retrieved first-party text does not separately adjudicate whether the three Slash variants share a name allowance; this remains an explicit interpretation without a dedicated client FAQ.

Wuyou samples five distinct names from the ordinary non-equipment anniversary family, independently of the remaining physical deck. Activity-only and skill-derived names are excluded unless explicitly part of the named family. Contributions are once per actual Play phase, donor and issuer owner; regrants do not reset that owner's phase allowance, while different issuers remain independent.

Wuyou may accept a self-contribution and a self-return through explicit gift facts without fabricating a Hand-to-same-Hand movement. The recipient's original returned Hand entity holds its named identity only for that uninterrupted residency. Leaving Hand ends future eligibility; an already accepted native use or declaration retains its exact signed material privilege.

Wuyou removes native distance and use-count gates only for the named original entity. Ordinary counters are still recorded, intrinsic Alcohol non-stacking and target prohibitions remain, and unrelated cards cannot borrow the privilege. A Wuyou entity can also be converted by Juewu when it independently meets Juewu's rank-two and true-Use requirements.

Yixian obtains all actual Equipment on the field including the user's, or all actual Equipment in DiscardPile. Compensation counts only original entities actually obtained in Hand from each field owner; destroyed General Weapons do not count as obtains. The DiscardPile branch has no field-owner compensation. Each accepted recipient uses native Draw and then Recovery; accepted child resolution survives source loss while a dead issuer opens no new optional menu.

Yixian's limited use is an ordinary game-scoped skill usage state, so future supported usage reset effects can clear it. No currently implemented Zhu Peilan reset producer was claimed or tested. Confirming an empty equipment branch spends the limited use; cancelling before branch confirmation does not.
